scripts.dev: npm run build -w @screen-sharing/protocol && concurrently -n protocol,signaling,desktop -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w @screen-sharing/protocol" "npm run dev -w @screen-sharing/signaling" "npm run dev -w @screen-sharing/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @screen-sharing/protocol && npm run build -w @screen-sharing/signaling && npm run build -w @screen-sharing/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @screen-sharing/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @screen-sharing/protocol && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
